# Claude Code Starter Kit

> Node.js / TypeScript / React プロジェクト向け Claude Code 拡張キット。12 の Skills（コーディング規約・バックエンド/フロントエンドパターン・TDD・セキュリティレビュー・ClickHouse 分析等）、10 の Rules（アンチパターン防止・Git ワークフロー・権限管理等）、9 の Agents（architect / planner / code-reviewer / tdd-guide / security-reviewer 等）を一括提供し、開発ライフサイクル全体を Claude Code でカバーする。

## Skills

- [backend-patterns](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/backend-patterns/SKILL.md): Backend architecture patterns, API design, database optimization, and server-side best practices for Node.js, Express, and Next.js API routes.
- [clickhouse-io](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/clickhouse-io/SKILL.md): ClickHouse database patterns, query optimization, analytics, and data engineering best practices for high-performance analytical workloads.
- [coding-standards](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/coding-standards/SKILL.md): Universal coding standards, best practices, and patterns for TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Node.js development.
- [continuous-learning](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/continuous-learning/SKILL.md): Automatically extract reusable patterns from Claude Code sessions and save them as learned skills for future use.
- [eval-harness](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/eval-harness/SKILL.md): Formal evaluation framework for Claude Code sessions implementing eval-driven development (EDD) principles.
- [frontend-patterns](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/frontend-patterns/SKILL.md): Frontend development patterns for React, Next.js, state management, performance optimization, and UI best practices.
- [project-guidelines-example](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/project-guidelines-example/SKILL.md): Example project-specific skill template. Use as a starting point when creating guidelines for your own projects.
- [prompt-patterns](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/prompt-patterns/SKILL.md): Practical prompt patterns and techniques for effective Claude Code usage. Reference when crafting prompts, planning workflows, or debugging interactions.
- [security-review](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/security-review/SKILL.md): Use this skill when adding authentication, handling user input, working with secrets, creating API endpoints, or implementing payment/sensitive features. Provides comprehensive security checklist and patterns.
- [strategic-compact](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/strategic-compact/SKILL.md): Suggests manual context compaction at logical intervals to preserve context through task phases rather than arbitrary auto-compaction.
- [tdd-workflow](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/tdd-workflow/SKILL.md): Use this skill when writing new features, fixing bugs, or refactoring code. Enforces test-driven development with 80%+ coverage including unit, integration, and E2E tests.
- [verification-loop](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/skills/verification-loop/SKILL.md): Comprehensive verification system for Claude Code sessions. Use after implementation to validate correctness.

## Agents

- [architect](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/architect.md): Software architecture specialist for system design, scalability, and technical decision-making. Use PROACTIVELY when planning new features, refactoring large systems, or making architectural decisions.
- [build-error-resolver](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/build-error-resolver.md): Build and TypeScript error resolution specialist. Use PROACTIVELY when build fails or type errors occur. Fixes build/type errors only with minimal diffs, no architectural edits. Focuses on getting the build green quickly.
- [code-reviewer](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/code-reviewer.md): Expert code review specialist. Proactively reviews code for quality, security, and maintainability. Use immediately after writing or modifying code. MUST BE USED for all code changes.
- [doc-updater](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/doc-updater.md): Documentation and codemap specialist. Use PROACTIVELY for updating codemaps and documentation. Runs /update-codemaps and /update-docs, generates docs/CODEMAPS/*, updates READMEs and guides.
- [e2e-runner](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/e2e-runner.md): End-to-end testing specialist using Playwright. Use PROACTIVELY for generating, maintaining, and running E2E tests. Manages test journeys, quarantines flaky tests, uploads artifacts (screenshots, videos, traces), and ensures critical user flows work.
- [planner](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/planner.md): Expert planning specialist for complex features and refactoring. Use PROACTIVELY when users request feature implementation, architectural changes, or complex refactoring. Automatically activated for planning tasks.
- [refactor-cleaner](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/refactor-cleaner.md): Dead code cleanup and consolidation specialist. Use PROACTIVELY for removing unused code, duplicates, and refactoring. Runs analysis tools (knip, depcheck, ts-prune) to identify dead code and safely removes it.
- [security-reviewer](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/security-reviewer.md): Security vulnerability detection and remediation specialist. Use PROACTIVELY after writing code that handles user input, authentication, API endpoints, or sensitive data. Flags secrets, SSRF, injection, unsafe crypto, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
- [tdd-guide](https://github.com/cloudnative-co/claude-code-starter-kit/blob/main/agents/tdd-guide.md): Test-Driven Development specialist enforcing write-tests-first methodology. Use PROACTIVELY when writing new features, fixing bugs, or refactoring code. Ensures 80%+ test coverage.
